content.text: Note: Relative potency: — = no standard equivalence scale
Antipsych: psychotic dx, N/V, agitation, depression, BD
-    Metabolism: CYP450 · active metabolites · absorb variable · dist wide volume (easy into CNS) · lots of protein binding (longer duration)
-    SE: Sz · EPS · neuroleptic malig syndrome · sedation · urine retention · ED · xerostomia · ↓BP · risk for met syndrome
-    MOA: competitive DA-D2 antagonist — mesolimbic -> ↓+sx · nigrostriatal -> parkinsonism & EPS
-    SE: EDS (excessive daytime sedation) · tardive dyskinesia
-    SE: very ↓sedation · very ↓anticholinergic · very ↑EPS · very ↓orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    SE: ↓sedation · ↓anticholinergic · ↑EPS (dystonia/akathisia common) · ↓orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    MOA: ↓potency D2 antagonist — most sedating · antiemetic
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · mania · N/V · hiccups
-    SE: orthostasis · anticholinergic · EPS (< ↑potency) · cholestatic jaundice (wk 2-4) · agranulocytosis (wk 4-10) · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    Admin: oral · IM · SC — long-acting decanoate depot
-    SE: EPS-dominant · ↓sedation/orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    Caution: pigmentary retinopathy at high doses (↓visual acuity, brownish vision, ↓night vision) · ⍉ w CYP2D6-i (fluoxetine, paroxetine) · ECG baseline (⍉ start QTc >450, stop >500)
-    BBW: QTc prolongation -> TdP/sudden death · reserve for refractory schizophrenia (fail ≥2 adequate trials) · ↑mortality — elderly w dementia-related psychosis
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · anxiety (short-term, ≤6 mg/day, ≤12 wk)
-    SE: EPS prominent · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    SE: EPS early · anticholinergic · mod sedation · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    Clin Use: Tourette tics (after haloperidol failure)
-    Caution: QT prolongation — ECG baseline + periodic · stop if QTc >0.47s (child) / 0.52s (adult) · ⍉ w macrolides, azoles, citalopram/escitalopram, sertraline, paroxetine, strong CYP2D6/3A4-i
-    MOA: inhibit 5HT-r — mesolimbic DA-D2 -> ↓+sx · mesocortical ↓5HT -> ↓-sx, help mood

-    SE: EPS/tardive dyskinesia -> anticholinergic · dystonia -> IM anticholinergic · parkinsonian -> oral anticholinergic · benztropine (Cogentin) IM 1-2 mg acute dystonia (PO 1-4 mg/day EPS) · trihexyphenidyl PO 5-15 mg/day (FYI)
-    Pt ed: screen EPS scales, PANSS
-    SE: ↑sedation · mod anticholinergic · very ↓EPS · mod orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    SE: ↑sedation · mod anticholinergic · ↓EPS · mod orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    MOA: weak D2 (low occupancy) + strong 5HT2A/D4/M1/H1 antagonist -> refractory efficacy + ⍉ EPS    -    met by CYP1A2 (smoking induces -> ↓levels)
-    Monitoring: ANC baseline ≥1500 (BEN ≥1000) · weekly x6M, q2wk M7-12, monthly after
-    Pt ed: levels ↓ by tobacco · ↑ by caffeine
-    BBW: severe neutropenia/agranulocytosis (ANC monitoring) · reserved for failed 2+ OR suicide risk · ↑Sz · orthostasis · fatal myocarditis/myopathy · ↑death (elderly, dementia)
-    Admin: oral · IM · SC — IM needs 3wk overlap of doses until therapeutic
-    SE: ↓sedation · very ↓anticholinergic · ↓EPS · mod orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death
-    SE: ↓sedation · very ↓anticholinergic · ↓EPS · ↓orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    Caution: ↑QTc — greatest of atypicals (⍉ w QT drugs/congenital long QT/recent MI/uncomp HF)
-    SE: ↓sedation · ↓anticholinergic · mod EPS · ↓orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death · hyperprolactinemia
-    MOA: D2 partial agonist -> dopamine stabilizer (partial DA tone: ⍉ overstim mesolimbic, ⍉ full block -> ↓EPS/prolactin)
-    Clin Use: psychotic dx · BD · adj MDD
-    SE: ↓sedation · very ↓anticholinergic · very ↓EPS · very ↓orthostasis · arrhythmias/sudden cardiac death
-    Note: DA-D2 block in medulla CTZ -> antiemetic
-    MOA: D2 + 5HT2A antagonist — active metabolite of risperidone
-    Admin: oral · IM — 6 mg/day (3-12) · LAI: Sustenna/Trinza/Hafyera
-    Caution: prolactin ↑ (like risperidone) · modest QTc · renal dosing
-    MOA: D2/D3 partial agonist -> dopamine stabilizer (D3-preferring)
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · bipolar mania + depression · MDD adj
-    Caution: long t½ — monitor response several wk after dose chg · EPS/akathisia dose-related
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · bipolar mania (mono + adj)
-    Admin: sublingual (Saphris) 5-10 mg BID — ⍉ swallow/chew · ⍉ eat/drink 10 min after · transdermal patch (Secuado) q24h
-    Caution: QT prolongation · orthostasis — 7-day titration required
-    MOA: D2 partial agonist + 5HT2A antagonist + glutamatergic
-    Clin Use: schizophrenia · bipolar depression (mono/adj) · MDD adj
-    Admin: oral · 42 mg/day, no titration · hepatic impair (Child-Pugh B/C) 21 mg qday · taper none specified
-    Caution: EPS/met ≈ placebo · somnolence 24% · CYP3A4 dose adjustment
